newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential upgrades PC group.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential upgrades PC group.

text.p: Prudential Securities analyst Don Young said he upgraded his rating on the personal computer industry group to buy from hold.
-- said reiterated Compaq Computer Corp as the "single best idea" in the group.
-- said in a note that expects the second quarter to mark "the bottom" and that sees the industry as poised for rapid acceleration in demand.
-- said he expected Compaq to announce a reengineering of its dealer channel on Thursday that will help the company gain market share with a lower pricing strategy.
-- Compaq is expected to report second quarter results Thursday.
-- Young said he believes lowered prices will cause more competitive pressure on companies such as Dell Computer Corp .
-- projected that Compaq's price cuts along with those made by Intel Corp will trigger a "dramatic buildup" in PC demand and shipments.
